fields.name: page-type
fields.label: Page Type
fields.description: The Site Global Template of the page (layout and template code). It also selects the template's default Navigation, Footer, header and footer variations and Canvas pages (the locale's Page Templates sheet, data/page-templates). Overrides the page-type column of the metadata sheet.

fields.name: nav
fields.label: Navigation
fields.description: Leave empty to use the shared header of the page's template (Page Templates sheet), else the nearest parent page's Navigation, else the locale's references/nav. Set only to override it for this page and, unless they set their own, its child pages (if the template allows page overrides). 'none' hides the header.

fields.name: footer
fields.label: Footer
fields.description: Leave empty to use the shared footer of the page's template (Page Templates sheet), else the nearest parent page's Footer, else the locale's references/footer. Set only to override it for this page and, unless they set their own, its child pages (if the template allows page overrides). 'none' hides the footer.

fields.name: error-page
fields.label: 404 Page
fields.description: The page shown when a page below this one isn't found. Empty: the nearest parent page's 404 Page (or the metadata sheet's error-page column), else the locale's error-pages/404.
